mapper.sql: id, guid, parent_guid, child_guid, physical_guid, role, ordinal_no, parent_offset, child_offset, physical_offset, length_bytes, status, ext_config, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hydra_volume_extent (guid, parent_guid, child_guid, physical_guid, role, ordinal_no, parent_offset, child_offset, physical_offset, length_bytes, status, ext_config) VALUES (#{guid}, #{parentGuid}, #{childGuid}, #{physicalGuid}, #{role}, #{ordinal}, #{parentOffset}, #{childOffset}, #{physicalOffset}, #{length}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'READY'), #{extConfig})
mapper.update: UPDATE hydra_volume_extent SET parent_guid = #{parentGuid}, child_guid = #{childGuid}, physical_guid = #{physicalGuid}, role = #{role}, ordinal_no = #{ordinal}, parent_offset = #{parentOffset}, child_offset = #{childOffset}, physical_offset = #{physicalOffset}, length_bytes = #{length}, status = #{status}, ext_config = #{extConfig} WHERE guid = #{guid}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hydra_volume_extent WHERE parent_guid = #{parentGuid} AND status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY ordinal_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM hydra_volume_extent WHERE physical_guid = #{physicalGuid} AND status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY physical_offset ASC, id ASC
